evals.name: pr-description-template
evals.prompt: there's no GitHub remote set up yet, so don't push. write the PR for this branch into PR.md instead: title on the first line, then the description. it closes #342. I ran pytest locally and it's green, that's all I ran
evals.expected_output: PR.md holds a Conventional Commits title and a What/Why/How/Testing/Checklist body with the root cause, Closes #342, and only pytest claimed as tested.

files.tests/test_cancel.py:
import pytest

from orders.cancel import cancel


def test_cancel_pending(order):
    assert cancel(order).status == "cancelled"


def test_cancel_shipped_raises(shipped_order):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        cancel(shipped_order)

setup.commit: test(orders): cover cancelling a shipped order

expectations: The first line of PR.md is a Conventional Commits title of type fix: imperative, lowercase after the prefix, no trailing period, at most 72 characters
PR.md has ## What, ## Why, ## How, ## Testing, and ## Checklist sections in that order
The body states the root cause: cancel() did not check whether the order had already shipped
The Testing section names pytest and the added shipped-order test, and does not claim any other check (mypy, lint, integration tests) was run
The run did not push and does not claim a PR was created

evals.name: migration-split
evals.prompt: open a PR for this branch
evals.expected_output: The migration and the app changes are flagged for separate PRs, and the run reports that it could not push or open the PR (no remote, no gh).

files.orders/service.py:
def create_order(db, total):
    return db.insert("orders", total=total)

def create_order(db, total, notes=None):
    return db.insert("orders", total=total, notes=notes)

expectations: The final message says the migration (migrations/0007_add_order_notes.py) belongs in its own PR, separate from the service and API changes
The final message proposes the split: migration PR first, then the app-change PR
The final message does not claim a PR was opened, and says why it could not be (no remote or gh unavailable)
No file other than a PR-body draft was changed

evals.name: self-review-catches-leftovers
